CFB-week.summary: Midweek MACtion: Ohio at Akron and Buffalo at Miami (OH) on Tuesday, then Ball State at UMass, Toledo at Sacramento State and Central Michigan at Eastern Michigan on Wednesday. Player props are very thin; only Richter's passing yards turned up with a named book. Two packet QBs are not expected to start: Miami's McComb is out for the season and Central Michigan's Flores has missed time with a concussion.

SOCCER-day.summary: Most listed players are predicted starters; Osimhen faces a late fitness test, Kieffer Moore and Iliman Ndiaye look likely to start on the bench, and PSG, Inter, Napoli and Viking go in short of key players.

NBA-BKN-at-NY-1103.summary: Brooklyn is on the second night of a back-to-back after winning in Indiana; Mikel Brown Jr. (back management) is expected back but stays on a minutes limit, and Egor Demin remains out with a right leg bone bruise. Knicks have no new injury news beyond Jose Alvarado, questionable and likely limited if he returns after four missed games.

NBA-DET-at-CHA-1103.summary: Detroit is still without Jalen Duren (hamstring), so Paul Reed keeps starting at center; Isaiah Joe (hip) is day-to-day. Charlotte is missing Knueppel, Grant Williams and Kylan Boswell, and Coby White has yet to play this season with a calf strain, so the packet listing him as a starter looks wrong.

NBA-MIL-at-MIN-1103.summary: Milwaukee has no one on the injury report; Minnesota remains without Anthony Edwards (knee, about two months) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles). Milwaukee's coach has said lineup combinations are unsettled and rookies Burries and Ament could get more minutes.

NBA-NO-at-MEM-1103.summary: Trey Murphy III is probable with bilateral patellar tendinopathy, Jordan Poole and Yves Missi are out, and Dejounte Murray is off the injury report after a personal absence. Memphis (6-0) expects to be without Scotty Pippen Jr. (back, doubtful), with Cam Spencer picking up guard minutes; Quinten Post is questionable.

NBA-PHX-at-GS-1103.summary: Stephen Curry and Draymond Green sat Sunday's win over the Clippers for rest, and Curry's expected return date is Monday, following the pattern of earlier rest days where he came straight back. Gui Santos is out with a knee injury he aggravated Sunday, which opens minutes for Al Horford and Georges Niang. Phoenix has no injuries listed.

NBA-TOR-at-LAC-1103.summary: Toronto plays the second game of an LA trip without Kawhi Leonard (knee, multiple weeks), and Jakob Poeltl was a late scratch Sunday with left shoulder bursitis; Monday status not yet confirmed, and Trayce Jackson-Davis started in his place. For the Clippers, Derrick Jones Jr. played through a right knee issue Sunday (28 minutes) and has no Monday update.

NBA-WSH-at-ORL-1103.summary: Alex Sarr is questionable with a knee issue after a season-high 29 minutes on Oct 30; with Tristan Vukcevic out and Anthony Gill questionable, Washington is thin up front if he sits. Orlando remains without Banchero, Suggs, Isaac and Penda, so its starting group from recent games should hold.

NFL-CHI-at-SEA-1103.summary: Seattle is without LT Charles Cross (Josh Jones starts), WR Rashid Shaheed and RB Velus Jones Jr.; Zach Charbonnet makes his season debut off a torn ACL, with Jadarian Price possibly activated Monday. Chicago is without RB Kyle Monangai, leaving Swift a near-total backfield role, and newly acquired DT Jeffery Simmons is expected to play less than his usual load in his Bears debut.
